linesEn: I'm completely exhausted...
Let's take a break here, everyone!

linesZhTw: 我們先在此休息一會兒，
linesZhCn: 我们先在此休息一会儿，
linesEn: They say the continent of Mara
lies just across this stretch of ocean.
Let's rest here for a while.

linesZhTw: 等海水漲潮適合上岸的時候
linesZhCn: 等海水涨潮适合上岸的时候
linesEn: Once the tide rises and it's safe to land,
the boatman will come pick us up.
Sounds great. Uni...
You've been on the boat for so long.
Are you feeling tired?
I'm doing fine, really.
The ocean breeze feels wonderful...

linesZhTw: 竟有呆鳥在這小島上休息，
真是天上掉下來的肥肉。』
linesZhCn: 竟有呆鸟在这小岛上休息，
真是天上掉下来的肥肉。』
linesEn: Look there!
A flock of sitting ducks resting on our island!
Talk about easy prey dropped right from the sky!

linesZhTw: 你們趕快把這些小伙子擺
linesZhCn: 你们赶快把这些小伙子摆
linesEn: You said it!
I'll go fetch the boss for backup.
You lot take care of these runts!
Ares, what are those guys
howling about over there?
Hmm... Hey, aren't they the pirates
the boatman warned us about?!
Pirates?
Are they trying to rob us?

linesZhTw: 這批海盜橫行馬拉大陸沿
linesZhCn: 这批海盗横行马拉大陆沿
linesEn: Robbery is just the start. They say this crew
terrorizes the entire coast of Mara,
pillaging and killing without mercy.
What?! If they want a fight, I'm game,
but they won't get a single coin from us!

linesZhTw: 亞雷斯，好久沒活動活動
linesZhCn: 亚雷斯，好久没活动活动
linesEn: Ares, it's been a while since we had a good workout.
Think you can handle it?!
Handle it? My sword hand's been itching so bad
I can hardly stand it!

linesZhTw: 乖乖的把身上的錢財和
linesZhCn: 乖乖的把身上的钱财和
linesEn: Hey, brats!
Hand over your valuables and that pretty girl,

linesZhTw: 我們就在老大面前說說好話
linesZhCn: 我们就在老大面前说说好话
linesEn: and we might put in a good word with the boss
to spare your lives! Otherwise...
What's a 'pretty girl'?
Do they mean me?
No, no! That's just...

linesZhTw: 你們這些亂說話的海盜，
linesZhCn: 你们这些乱说话的海盗，
linesEn: Damn you filthy pirates!
Watch your filthy mouths!
I'm going to cut you all down!
Oho, looks like the little whelps
want to put up a fight!
Then show no mercy!
Charge!
Good grief, what's all that infernal racket?
What's going on out there...?
Dad!
There's a fight breaking out on the island!
What? Let me see...
Aha, aren't those pirates
trying to mug some travelers?
Robbing folks right on our doorstep?
They've got some nerve!
They sure do!
Dad, what should we do?

linesZhTw: 這可是絕佳的歷練機會，
我們就幫他們一個忙吧！』
linesZhCn: 这可是绝佳的历练机会，
我们就帮他们一个忙吧！』
linesEn: Son, this is the perfect chance for combat practice.
Let's go lend them a hand!
Hey, old-timer!
What are you two doing here?
If you don't want to get hurt, stay clear!

linesZhTw: 我們是來幫你們打退海盜
linesZhCn: 我们是来帮你们打退海盗
linesEn: Easy there, lad.
We're here to help you drive off these pirates.
What? A handful of pirates like this
is nothing we can't handle!
Go on back home!
Come on, Thor. They mean well.
Couldn't you be a little more polite?

linesZhTw: 老頭子，如果你要幫忙的話
linesZhCn: 老头子，如果你要帮忙的话
linesEn: Oh, fine... Hey, old man!
If you're really helping out,
then thanks in advance!
These youngsters sure have plenty of fire!
Let's move, son!
Right behind you, Dad!

linesZhTw: 弟兄們好像陷入苦戰呢！』
linesZhCn: 弟兄们好像陷入苦战呢！』
linesEn: Uh-oh,
the boys look like they're in trouble!
What are we waiting for? Let's move in!

linesZhTw: 連這些小鬼都收拾不了，
linesZhCn: 连这些小鬼都收拾不了，
linesEn: What in the world are you idiots doing?!
Can't even take down a few snot-nosed brats?
Making me step in—have you no shame?!
Hmph. What does this ugly, noisy brute
want now?

linesZhTw: 總算有個像樣的對手上場了
這傢伙就交給我來處理啦！
linesZhCn: 总算有个像样的对手上场了
这家伙就交给我来处理啦！
linesEn: Must be their captain!
Finally, a decent opponent to cut down.
Leave this one to me!
No way!
Handling tough guys like him is my job!
Step aside, he's mine!

linesZhTw: 就為了在喜歡的女孩子
linesZhCn: 就为了在喜欢的女孩子
linesEn: Some friend you are, Thor!
Just trying to look tough
in front of the girl you like!
Wh-what kind of nonsense is that?!
Say that again and I'll—
Hey! What are you two bickering about?!
Save your squabbling for hell!
Shut your trap!
Get lost!
This guy really gets on my nerves.
Thor, truce for now.
Let's take him down together first!
Deal! Let's do it!
Curse you! You dare mock me, you little runts?!
Kill them! Leave no one standing!

linesZhTw: 現在正是我們海防隊建功
linesZhCn: 现在正是我们海防队建功
linesEn: Look! Pirates wreaking havoc again!
Here's our chance to bring honor to the Coastal Guard!
Quite a crowd gathering today!
And who might you fellows be?

linesZhTw: 『我們是亞克斯王國的海岸巡
防隊，消滅肆虐沿海的海盜
本是我們的職責，這些海盜
linesZhCn: 『我们是亚克斯王国的海岸巡
防队，消灭肆虐沿海的海盗
本是我们的职责，这些海盗
linesEn: We are the Coastal Guard of the Kingdom of Ax.
Wiping out pirates who plunder our shores is our duty!

linesZhTw: 就交給我們來處理，請各位
linesZhCn: 就交给我们来处理，请各位
linesEn: Leave these sea dogs to us.
Rest easy, citizens!
Nonsense! We were just getting warmed up!
We don't need you crashing our fight!

linesZhTw: 我們就要踏進人家的地盤，
linesZhCn: 我们就要踏进人家的地盘，
linesEn: Thor, please!
We're about to enter their kingdom's lands.
Show some basic courtesy!
Think nothing of it!
We're coming in to assist!
Dad, I... I can't hold out any longer!
Fall back to the house and rest, son!
Your old man will hold the line!
All right, Dad! I'm heading back!
You filthy pirates!
How dare you wound my boy!
I'll take every last one of you down!

linesZhTw: 手的小子在先，又遇上王國
海防隊，真是天亡我也！啊
linesZhCn: 手的小子在先，又遇上王国
海防队，真是天亡我也！啊
linesEn: Curse my luck!
First these monstrous whelps, and now the Coastal Guard?!
Heaven has forsaken me! Aaargh...!

linesZhTw: 我們才能順利打敗海盜。』
linesZhCn: 我们才能顺利打败海盗。』
linesEn: Thank you so much, sir, and your son as well.
Thanks to you, we drove off the pirates.

linesZhTw: 除了偶爾出去遊歷外，平常
也閒來無事，幫你們打打海
linesZhCn: 除了偶尔出去游历外，平常
也闲来无事，帮你们打打海
linesEn: Don't mention it! My boy and I live on this island,
and aside from our occasional travels,
we have plenty of time on our hands.

linesZhTw: 對了，說到這個，老頭子我
linesZhCn: 对了，说到这个，老头子我
linesEn: Bashing a few pirates was nothing at all.
Though speaking of that,
this old man has a favor to ask.
Please, sir, go ahead.

linesZhTw: 『我瞧我這小子和你們滿合得
來的，希望你們能帶他同行
linesZhCn: 『我瞧我这小子和你们满合得
来的，希望你们能带他同行
linesEn: It looks to me like my boy gets along well with you.
I was hoping you'd let him journey with you
so he can see the world and gain experience.

linesZhTw: 一番。我從小教了他不少武
術，當你們有麻煩的時候，
相信他也可以幫上一點忙。
linesZhCn: 一番。我从小教了他不少武
术，当你们有麻烦的时候，
相信他也可以帮上一点忙。
linesEn: I've drilled him in combat since he was small.
When trouble strikes,
I'm sure he can pull his weight.
Well, that's a bit...

linesZhTw: 沒問題的啦！悠妮妳說是不
linesZhCn: 没问题的啦！悠妮你说是不
linesEn: Come now! Of course that won't be a problem!
Right, Uni?
Having another companion along
will make the road much more lively!

linesZhTw: 小子啊，來向大家打個招呼
linesZhCn: 小子啊，来向大家打个招呼
linesEn: Thank you all so much!
Son, come introduce yourself to everyone!

linesZhTw: 以後請…請大家多多指教
linesZhCn: 以后请…请大家多多指教
linesEn: I-I'm Harno...
P-pleased to be in your care!

linesZhTw: 遇到危難時要同心協力，
linesZhCn: 遇到危难时要同心协力，
linesEn: You're one of our comrades now.
Let's stand together and look out for each other,
all right?
Y-yes, sir!

linesZhTw: 我這小子就拜託你們啦！』
linesZhCn: 我这小子就拜托你们啦！』
linesEn: High tide should be arriving soon.
You folks best get ready to depart.
I'm leaving my boy in your hands!
Don't worry, old-timer!
We're on our way!
How could this happen...?!
Dad! Dad!
